newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila C. Bank confirms o/night borrowing rate.
newsitem.headline: Manila C. Bank confirms o/night borrowing rate.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank on Monday confirmed that its key overnight borrowing rate would be unchanged at 20 percent.
Treasurer Sergio Edeza also told Reuters that the Bank's overnight lending rate is being adjusted to 22 percent from a previously reported 21 percent.
Last Thursday and Friday, it raised the borrowing rate by a total of 8.75 percentage points to fend off speculation on the peso following the problems of the Thai baht.
